t: Shiur akila beyom hakkippurim veshiur kammutah
s: Shiur akila beyom hakkippurim veshiur kammutah ubo t"z seipim: akila ketzad? Haokel beyom hakkippurim shiur shekkeshehu raeb tityashsheb alayv dato baakila zo — chayyab karet, shenneemar "ki kol hannepesh asher lo teunneh vego'", ukesheokel kashshiur hazzeh — hare eno meunneh, veqibbelu chakamim halaka lemosheh missinay sheshshiur zeh hu kekotebet haggassa, vehu pachot meat mikkebetza. Veshiur zeh shaveh lekol adam, ben lenannas ben leog melek habbashan, lepi shekkol adam kesheyyirab tityashsheb alayv dato baakila kashshiur hazzeh, ella sheog melek habbashan tityashsheb dato meat ushear kol adam mityashshebet datam harbeh:

Kol hookalin mitztorpin zeh im zeh lehashlim leshiur zeh. Abal okalin umashqin sheakal chatzi shiur veshata chatzi shiur — en mitztorpin, lepi sheen dato mityashshebet bekak. Abal haokel yaraq im hatztzir shealayv, veken basar im hammelach shealayv — hare hatztzir vehammelach mitztorpin lehashlim lekashshiur, lepi shekkol mashqeh habba lehakshir et haokel — hare hu keokel:

Shette akilot mitztorpot, kegon sheakal meat vehipsiq vechazar veakal meat ad shehishlim lekashshiur — mitztorpin, vehu shello shaha[h] mittechillat akila rishona ad sop akila acharona yoter mikkede akilat peras (perush chatzi kikkar lechem), abal im shaha[h] yoter mikkede akilat peras — en mitztorpin, lepi sheen dato mityashshebet baakila mupseqet kazo:

Shiur akilat peras sheameru beyom hakkippurim ubekol issure tora, ben shehen min hattora ben shehen middibre soperim, yesh omerim shehu kemo d' betzim, veyesh omerim shehu kemo g' betzim sochaqot, kelomar bemilluy uberevach velo betzimtzum. Uleinyan halaka, kol shehu beshel tora — hallek achar hammachamir, vekol shehu beshel dibrehem — hallek achar hammeqel:

Haokel beyom hakkippurim akila gassa, kegon shelleachar sheakal harbeh beereb yom hakkippurim akal miyyad beyom hakkippurim bitchillat hallayla keshehaya adayin sabea umale meakilat ereb yom hakkippurim, veeno neheneh kelal meakila gassa zo, vehi mazzeqet legupo, lepikak hu patur mikkaret, shenneemar "asher lo teunneh" — perat lemazziq gupo baakila, shehu meunneh:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheakal maakalim sheenam reuyim ella lemi shehu raeb, abal im akal maakalim hareuyim ap lemi shehu sabea, kegon maakalim hamtubbalim vehambussamim sheyyesh bahem hanaa laggup ap lassabea — chayyab ap al pi sheakalan al hassoba, deravcha lebissuma shekiach. Vehu shello akal harbeh kol kak beereb yom hakkippurim ad sheyyaqutz bekol mine mazon, abal im qatz bimzono ap al pi sheakal maakal mebussam — patur, veen dabar zeh taluy ella lepi mah shemmargish benapsho im yesh lo hanaa baakila gassa zo:

Hanaat akila ushetiyya asura beyom hakkippurim ap al pi sheeno okelo veshotehu, kegon shettoem lachek upolet, vaapillu debarim sheenam reuyim laakila, kegon atze besamim veetz matoq — asur litom kede lelachleach gerono veliplot kemo shennitbaer besiman tqs"z. Abal muttar lehariach kol mine reach beyom hakkippurim, lepi shehareach hu dabar sheen haggup neheneh mimmennu kelal ella hanneshama bilbad nehenet mimmennu, lepikak lo neesar beyom hakkippurim, veadderabba tob lehariach kede lemalleot minyan mea berakot:
Akal okalim sheenam reuyim laakilat adam, ap al pi sheakal harbeh mehem — patur min hakkaret, abal makkin oto makkat mardut:
Akal ale qanim — patur, lepi sheenan maakal adam:

Akal lulebe gepanim shelliblebu qodem rosh hashshana — patur, deetz beolma hem, veim liblebu achar rosh hashshana adayin hem rakkim beyom hakkippurim ureuyim laakilat adam, ulepikak im akalan beyom hakkippurim — chayyab:
Akal pilpelin yebeshim vezangebil yabesh — patur, lepi sheenan reuyim laakila. Akalan keshehen retubbin, sheaz hen reuyim laakila — chayyab:

Hashshoteh beyom hakkippurim kimlo lugmayv — chayyab, umeshaarin bimlo lugmayv shel hashshoteh atzmo kol adam lepi mah shehu, haggadol lepi godlo vehaqqatan lepi qotno, velo melo lugmayv mammash, ella kol sheillu mesalleqo letzad echad mippiv veyeraeh kimlo lugmayv, vehu pachot merebiit hallog beadam benoni:
Kol hammashqin mitztorpin zeh im zeh lehashlim kimlo lugmayv:

(Shata mashqin sheenam reuyim lishtiyya, kegon tzir o mureyas (perush tzir shel dagim), o chometz chay (perush sheeno mazug bemayim) shehu chazaq kol kak sheim yashliku oto al haaretz yebabea, ap al pi sheshshata harbeh mehen — patur min hakkaret, abal makkin oto makkot mardut. Abal im shata chometz mazug bemayim, apillu lo shata ella kimlo lugmayv — chayyab):

Shetiyyot mitztorpot zo im zo, kegon sheshshata meat vehipsiq meat vechazar veshata meat uben shettehen yesh kimlo lugmayv — chayyab. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshello shaha mittechillat shetiyya rishona ad sop shetiyya acharona yoter mikkede shetiyyat rebiit hallog, abal im shaha yoter mikkede shetiyyat rebiit — en mitztorpin. Veyesh omerim shelleolam hen mitztorpin, ella im ken shaha mittechillat shetiyya rishona ad sop shetiyya acharona yoter mikkede akilat peras, kemo betzerup shette akilot. Uleinyan halaka, yesh lehachamir lekattechilla velipsoq kassebara haacharona kemo sheyyitbaer besiman try"ch, ayyen sham:

Kol shiurin hallalu shennitbaaru besiman zeh, ben shiur akila ben shiur shetiyya — lo neemru ella leinyan chiyyub chattat (vegam lanu yesh napqa minnah leinyan choleh sheyyesh bo sakkana kemo sheyyitbaer sham), abal leinyan issur apillu akal kol shehu veshata kol shehu — hare asa issur min hattora, veken haddin bekol issurin shebbattora shenneemar bahem shiurim, sheapillu bemashshehu mehen yesh issur min hattora:
